The '''Telanka system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Svivreni sector/Legends|Svivreni sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Vessar Asteroid Field]], which included [[Buula's Rocky Home]].
